information: This is a competition is organized by the Brown University Speedcubing Club. The base registration fee is $25, and there is a 100 person competitor limit. Use Brown Marketplace to pay for the registration fee: https://payment.brown.edu/C20460_ustores/web/product_detail.jsp?PRODUCTID=5888 Please indicate that you have paid the registration fee by stating "Paid" through making a comment. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5NTU1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a59ba1b843150337e539fb2a43401584b39ecdc9/photo_5249284943450861288_y%20(1).jpg)
